compiled_state.description:
## Story DD Coverage
- dd-2: implementation-plan Step 4 (Plan Review) re-dispatches dso:task-decomposer with mode: remediation when plan-reviewer findings contain items targeting the task list

## Testing Mode
RED (bundled: create test fixture + edit SKILL.md Step 4 in same task — Gate 2 requires both)

## Files to Modify
- tests/scripts/test-implementation-plan-step4-remediation.sh (Create — RED test fixture)
- plugins/dso/skills/implementation-plan/SKILL.md (Edit — add Remediation Re-dispatch subsection to Step 4)

## Acceptance Criteria
1. tests/scripts/test-implementation-plan-step4-remediation.sh exists and is executable
2. Test file asserts presence of Remediation Re-dispatch subsection in Step 4 section of SKILL.md using awk-scoped extraction (awk '/^## Step 4/,/^## Step [56]/')
3. Test asserts: trigger condition block present (grep -q 'plan-reviewer.*findings\|findings.*plan-reviewer\|REMEDIATION_DISPATCH\|remediation re-dispatch' within scoped section)
4. Test asserts: dso:task-decomposer re-dispatch present (grep -q 'task-decomposer' within scoped section)
5. Test asserts: model: "opus" literal present within scoped section
6. Test asserts: remediation_context block with reviewer_artifact_paths present within scoped section
7. Test asserts: delta-mode preservation clause present (grep -q 'delta\|DELTA\|preserve.*omission' within scoped section)
8. Test asserts: SC5 single-comment instruction present (grep -q 'SC5\|single.*comment\|one.*comment' within scoped section)
9. SKILL.md Step 4 section contains Remediation Re-dispatch subsection with all required elements (verified by test passing RED→GREEN after SKILL.md edit in same task commit)
10. Run: bash tests/scripts/test-implementation-plan-step4-remediation.sh → all assertions PASS
